transcript.content: Hi, this is Sophia Silva. My confirmation number is H8Q05L. I'm calling because I'm not happy with the service, and I want to cancel the insurance on my reservation and get a full refund. I do not want to cancel the flight itself—just the insurance.
I'll look up your reservation to see the details.

I can see your reservation includes insurance ($30 charge, which makes up the $104 total with the $74 flight). However, our policy does not allow insurance to be removed or refunded after the initial booking. Once insurance is purchased at the time of booking, it cannot be cancelled or adjusted.

If you'd like to cancel the entire reservation and rebook without insurance, I can help with that. Otherwise, the insurance will remain on your current booking.
